connector.name: three.ws Coin Clash
connector.registryDescription: Play three.ws Coin Clash - read the faction battle board and leaderboard, enlist, and rally.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package clash-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nirholas account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: THREE_WS_BASE
env.description: Base URL of the three.ws API that serves the Coin Clash endpoints. Override only when self-hosting or targeting a preview deployment.

env.name: THREE_WS_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for the live Coin Clash reads and writes.

env.name: SOLANA_SECRET_KEY
env.description: Base58 Solana secret key for the enlisting wallet. Required only for the write tools (enlist_faction, rally_faction) — reads work without it. Per-call `secret` arguments override this. The wallet must hold the faction coin it enlists for. Treat like cash.
